title: Junior Manager
description: Company Description BETA is a dynamic, product-based software company focused on engineering high-performance digital solutions for both individuals and organizations. The company designs, builds, and launches a suite of proprietary applications ranging from intuitive consumer-facing tools to robust, scalable platforms for enterprises. Its work centers on simplifying daily routines, streamlining complex workflows, and delivering immediate value through exceptional user experiences. Guided by technical excellence and human-centric design, BETA develops software that is powerful, secure, and accessible to a wide range of users. Team members join a forward-looking environment that values innovation, quality, and impact.Role Description The Junior Manager role at BETA is a full-time, on-site position based in Tiruvallur. The Junior Manager will assist in planning and coordinating daily operational activities, ensuring that product and project teams stay aligned with timelines, quality standards, and organizational goals. This role involves supporting senior managers with task tracking, preparing reports, facilitating team communication, and helping resolve routine issues that may affect delivery or performance. The Junior Manager will collaborate with cross-functional teams, contribute to process improvements, and help maintain documentation and workflows to support efficient project execution. The role also includes participating in internal meetings, monitoring progress against objectives, and contributing to a positive, inclusive work culture.Qualifications Strong organizational and coordination skills, including task prioritization, time management, and basic project tracking.Effective communication and interpersonal skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and presenting clear updates to stakeholders.Foundational analytical and problem-solving abilities, with capacity to interpret data, identify issues, and support practical solutions.Basic understanding of software or IT environments, with interest in product-based companies and technology-driven operations.Proficiency in common office and productivity tools (e.g., spreadsheets, presentation software, documentation tools).Ability to work on-site in Tiruvallur, adapt to changing priorities, and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced setting.Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.Prior internship or junior-level experience in operations, coordination, or project support is an advantage.
